environment_variables.name: B61N_SINGULAR_RUNTIME_TEST_BINARY
environment_variables.description: Optional path override for the singular-runtime-lane-tests executable used by the b61n publication audit-trail verifier.
environment_variables.default_behavior: When unset, tools/reference-harness/scripts/verify_b61n_publication_audit_trail.py first honors --test-binary and then searches common build output paths such as build/singular-runtime-lane-tests and cmake-build-debug/singular-runtime-lane-tests.
environment_variables.failure_mode: If no --test-binary, environment override, or common-path candidate exists, the verifier raises a checked-path RuntimeError. The CTest entry passes --test-binary explicitly, so normal builds do not require this variable.

environment_variables.name: B63N_WEIGHTED_RESIDUE_TEST_BINARY
environment_variables.description: Optional path override for the cutkosky-weighted-residue-tests executable used by b63n weighted-residue audit tools.
environment_variables.default_behavior: When unset, tools/reference-harness/scripts/verify_b63n_scoped_gate_audit_trail.py and tools/reference-harness/scripts/regenerate_b63n_weighted_residue_fingerprints.py first honor --test-binary and then search common build output paths such as build/cutkosky-weighted-residue-tests and cmake-build-debug/cutkosky-weighted-residue-tests.
environment_variables.failure_mode: If no --test-binary, environment override, or common-path candidate exists, the verifier/regenerator raises a checked-path RuntimeError. The CTest entries pass --test-binary explicitly, so normal builds do not require this variable.

non_dependency_environment_uses.description: Copies the current process environment into a nested CTest subprocess and sets AMFLOW_COVERAGE_BASELINE_NESTED there. No repo code reads AMFLOW_COVERAGE_BASELINE_NESTED at this commit, so it is recorded as a subprocess environment write/pass-through rather than a named build/runtime dependency.

Copies the current process environment into the environment passed to the external Kira subprocess, then applies explicit PreparedCommand.environment_overrides such as FERMATPATH. This is a pass-through of the caller environment, not a named repo configuration dependency.
